main_text.p: ut verius dicamus, ut ingenti sublimium, & Christianissimorum nostrorum Imperatorum, & ante vim illatam, consensu precibusque universæ Dei Constantinopolitanæ Ecclesiæ. His acquiescunt Romani, sic turbante ac convoluente omnia Photio. Est tamen id contra Constitutiones, & canones Ecclesiasticos, quod alibi fusius probavimus. Ante siquidem omnia assensus Romani requirebatur, & pœnitentia prævia. Sed nolo cum aliis contendere. Calculum Photius det, non longe sed ab hac eadem Actione petitum. Peccavit in Potium Thomas Berytensis Photium respuens, postmodum pœnitentia ductus, si hoc quoque mendacium[?] Photij non est, delictum confitetur, & in communionem petit admitti. Sed esto, erraverit ille, & pœnitentiam egerit, ut hoc Photio concedam. Nanque in Epistola Michaëlis Alexandrini legitur; Ο᾿ ἀ[?]έπεμψω αὐτὸν Θωμᾶς ὁ Βηρυταῖος ἐπίγνω τὸ πλάσμα Ἰωάννου, ἐ αἰτίαν [illegible, ~12 letters] συγγνώμης. Alius vero ipsorum Thomas Berytensis agnovit errorem suum, & cum postulasset veniam, illam a nobis impetravit: Et Abramius Amedorum, & Samosatorum Metropolita Epistolam ad Photium de eodem Thoma, Περὶ μὲν οὖν Θωμᾶ τῆς Τύρου, καὶ Ἡλίας, καὶ Ἰωάννη τῷ ἀπεσταλμένῳ[?] τῷ

page.notes: Greek passages are only partly legible at this scan resolution; uncertain Greek letters and words are marked [?] or left as illegible. "refpuens" is read as respuens, and "mendaciim" as mendacium, both uncertain. "det" is printed as seen (possibly a printing error for dedit). Long s and u/v were normalised as instructed. No running head, catchword or signature is visible.
